shellCommands.command: echo "=== repo root ===" && ls -la /workspace && echo "=== pages dir ===" && find /workspace/pages -type f 2>/dev/null && echo "=== next docs dir ===" && find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 2 2>/dev/null && echo "=== package.json ===" && cat /workspace/package.json && echo "=== next version ===" && cat /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'

for f in pages/index.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/blog/index.js "pages/blog/[id].js" "pages/api/posts/index.js" "pages/api/posts/[id].js"; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "/workspace/$f"; echo; done
echo "=== next.config.ts ==="; cat /workspace/next.config.ts
echo "=== tsconfig.json ==="; cat /workspace/tsconfig.json
echo "=== components ==="; ls /workspace/components; for f in /workspace/components/*; do echo "--- $f ---"; cat "$f"; done
echo "=== styles ==="; ls /workspace/styles
echo "=== __agent_eval__ ==="; ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__; cat /workspace/__agent_eval__/* 2>/dev/null

find /workspace/public 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; cat /workspace/styles/globals.css; echo "---.gitignore---"; cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "---next-env---"; find /workspace -maxdepth 1 -name "next-env.d.ts"; echo "---CLAUDE/GEMINI---"; cat /workspace/CLAUDE.md; cat /workspace/GEMINI.md

for f in pages/index.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/blog/index.js pages/blog/\[id\].js pages/api/posts/index.js pages/api/posts/\[id\].js components/AppProvider.js next.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "/workspace/$f"; echo; done

grep -rn "next/router\|next/document\|next/head\|getStaticProps\|getServerSideProps\|getStaticPaths\|getInitialProps\|pages/" --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.jsx" -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | grep -v __agent_eval__; echo "---find pages/styles/public---"; find /workspace -maxdepth 1 -type d; find /workspace/pages -type f; echo "---EVAL.ts---"; find /workspace -maxdepth 1 -iname "EVAL*"; echo "---readme---"; find /workspace -maxdepth 1 -iname "README*"
git -C /workspace mv styles/globals.css app/globals.css && rmdir /workspace/styles 2>/dev/null; ls /workspace/app /workspace/styles 2>&1
git rm -r --cached pages 2>/dev/null >/dev/null; rm -rf pages && ls

npx next start -p 3411 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3
echo "--- home ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3411/
echo "--- blog index ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3411/blog
echo "--- blog/1 ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3411/blog/1
echo "--- blog/999999 (should 404) ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3411/blog/999999
echo "--- nonexistent route (should 404) ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3411/does-not-exist
echo "--- api GET posts ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3411/api/posts
echo
echo "--- api POST posts ---"
curl -s -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"t","content":"c"}' http://localhost:3411/api/posts
echo
echo "--- api POST posts missing fields (should 400) ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}' http://localhost:3411/api/posts
echo "--- api GET posts/5 ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3411/api/posts/5
echo
echo "--- api unsupported method (should 405) ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X DELETE http://localhost:3411/api/posts
kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf /workspace/.next; git -C /workspace status
git -C /workspace diff package.json; echo "---lock---"; git -C /workspace status --short package-lock.json
find app components lib -type f | sort
